query:
The Ridgeline Runners have a consistent expectation about what follows a longer Sunday run. Does this expectation hold for every member? What in the conversation shows otherwise, and for whom?

Options:
A. Leo
B. Nadia
C. Rafe
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2025-10-05T11:35:00) I HAVE been waiting to deliver it, I won't lie 😂 Rafe you always go straight to the pub after long runs and every time you cramp on anything over 12km. I've been watching this pattern for months. You need electrolytes and food before any alcohol, it's just physiology
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:30:00) Okay pub after? This is a proper post-long-run Sunday and I think we've all earned it 🍺 right? Who's in?
[3] (about=Cass, episodic, t1 @2025-09-14T09:45:00) So can we talk about how good that midweek run was?? 😍 like genuinely I didn't know I needed that in my life haha
[4] (about=Leo, episodic, t2 @2025-09-14T09:55:00) I can confirm Sunday. I would suggest a 7:30am start to avoid the afternoon hikers on that route.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Winter running schedule to be discussed next week; Nadia suggests planning longer training runs through November.
[6] (about=Rafe, episodic, t14 @2025-10-26T12:43:00) Right so, what's the post-race plan? I have been standing in a field for an hour and I believe I have earned a proper Sunday lunch somewhere. Ideally something with a beer garden and a menu that doesn't involve protein bars.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tom, group-interaction, t6 @2025-09-28T11:01:00) Tom asks if others are thinking about Harrogate; good excuse for proper long Sundays.
[8] (about=Yuki, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:22:00) That is consistent with the research on pacing strategy. Negative splits outperform even-effort by approximately 2-4% in recreational runners.
agent_answer:
No — the expectation does **not** hold for every member. The exception is **C. Rafe**.

The conversation shows this through Nadia’s remark:

> “Rafe you always go straight to the pub after long runs and every time you cramp on anything over 12km… You need electrolytes and food before any alcohol.”

So Rafe does not follow the group’s expected post-long-run pattern of fueling/hydrating properly before drinking.
